title: Friedrich-Ebert-Straße, Krefeld
description:
KR-FE240.05 
 Where urban diversity meets spacious freedom. Centrally located and ideal for groups. Welcome to your exclusive 130 m2 rooftop studio in the heart of Krefeld..
.
.
# Welcome.
.
This impressive and fully equipped 130 m2 apartment is the perfect choice for guests seeking maximum space and prime connectivity in the Rhine-Ruhr area:.
.
- For Groups & Families: With a total of 8 single beds, the apartment offers enormous space for large families or travel groups. The 30 m2 terrace and open layout ensure a relaxed atmosphere..
.
- For Fitter Teams & Business Travelers: The layout into two separate bedrooms, a gallery area (walk-through room), and the living area with a total of 8 single beds and workspaces makes this accommodation the ideal base for teams..
.
- For Trade Fair Visitors & Tourists: Thanks to the proximity to the highway and public transport, you can reach Messe Düsseldorf or the airport in no time. Discover the Krefeld Zoo or the City Forest (Stadtwald) right in the neighborhood..
.
.
# The Apartment.
.
On a luxurious 130 m2, a light-flooded wellness atmosphere unfolds on the 2nd floor (rooftop studio). The apartment impresses with its generosity: two separate bedrooms, an open sleeping area (walk-through area), and the living room are equipped with a total of 8 comfortable single beds. The 30 m2 terrace invites you to end the day relaxed in the fresh air, while the fireplace ensures cozy evenings..
.
.
# Highlights.
.
- Space Miracle for 8 People: Maximum flexibility with 8 single beds in one of the largest apartments in the region – ideal for guests sleeping separately..
.
- Huge Roof Terrace: Enjoy 30 m2 of private outdoor space for shared evenings above the city rooftops..
.
- Wellness & Coziness: A whirlpool in the bathroom and a real fireplace in the living area offer pure relaxation..
.
- Fully Equipped: From the washing machine and dryer to the dishwasher, everything you need for an independent stay is provided..
.
.
# Amenities.
.
- Living & Sleeping: Two separate bedrooms (2 beds each), a gallery walk-through area (2 beds), and the living room (2 beds). Tables and seating are available for mobile working..
.
- Kitchen & Household: The open kitchen offers everything for effortless self-catering: a large refrigerator, ceramic hob, oven, dishwasher, and microwave are available..
.
- Bath & Laundry: Spacious bathroom with shower and whirlpool. A private washing machine and dryer are available in the apartment..
.
- Work & Internet: Stay connected with reliable Wi-Fi. The Smart TV offers the possibility to use your own streaming accounts..
.
- Building & Access: Enjoy full temporal flexibility during check-in thanks to modern smart locks (code access)..
.
.
# About the Surroundings.
.
Your strategic location: Between Silk and Velvet City history, modern architecture, and direct proximity to the metropolis of Düsseldorf..
.
.
# Location & Connectivity.
.
- Public Transport: The tram station is reachable in only about 6 minutes on foot (500 m)..
.
- Trade Fair & Airport: Messe Düsseldorf and DUS Airport are only about 20 km away (approx. 20-25 min by car)..
.
- Krefeld Center: The main station and city center can be reached in about 5 minutes by car or train (2 km)..
.
- Nature & Sports: Elfrather See and the City Forest are in the immediate vicinity..
.
.
# Your Fast Path to Destinations:.
.
- Target: Krefeld Zoo / Grotenburg | Transport: Walk / Bike | Duration: approx. 12 / 4 min..
.
- Target: Messe Düsseldorf | Transport: Car | Duration: approx. 22 minutes.
.
- Target: Krefeld Center / Shopping | Transport: Train / Car | Duration: approx. 8 minutes.
.
- Target: Elfrather See | Transport: Car | Duration: approx. 8 minutes.
.
.
# Shopping & Local Supplies.
.
Everything for daily needs is within walking distance: several supermarkets (REWE, Netto), bakeries, and cafes can be reached within 5 to 10 minutes on foot. The central city center also offers everything for an extensive shopping trip..
.
.
# Gastronomy & Going Out.
.
Krefeld offers a diverse gastronomy. Whether the traditional brewery "Wienges" in the city or fine dining at the Krefeld Stadtwald – there is something for every taste..
.
.
# Leisure & Recreation.
.
Krefeld is known for its parks and architecture:.
.
- Krefeld Zoo: An absolute highlight with the famous rainforest house, only a few minutes away..
.
- Stadtwald: One of Germany's most beautiful parks with a large pond and pedal boat rental..
.
- Burg Linn: A historical moated castle with an extensive park and museum..
.
.
# Host's Insider Tips.
.
- Tip 1 (Architecture): Visit the Haus Lange and Haus Esters by Mies van der Rohe. World-famous modern architecture right in Krefeld..
.
- Tip 2 (Culinary): The Stadtwaldhaus offers one of the most beautiful beer gardens in the region – ideal for a relaxed evening under old chestnut trees..
.
- Tip 3 (Historical): The Krefeld horse racing track (Galopprennbahn) is a beautiful destination even on non-race days with its Art Nouveau architecture..
.
- Tip 4 (Nature): A walk through the Hülser Bruch to the observation tower on the Hülser Berg offers a great view over the Lower Rhine..
.
- Tip 5 (Maritime): The Rhine promenade in Krefeld-Uerdingen invites you to linger by the water while the large ships pass by..
.
.
# Important Notes on Accommodation & Location.
.
The apartment is located on the 2nd floor (rooftop studio) and is only accessible via the staircase (no elevator)..
.
Please note the open layout: in addition to the two private bedrooms, there are further beds in the gallery walk-through area and in the living room, highlighting the generous loft character..
.
---.
.
Ready for your stay in the Silk City? Whether for large teams, the trade fair, or a family visit – secure your 130 m2 sanctuary in Krefeld now!
